title: SMPCRAFT
description: Built for pure comfort and immersion on private servers. Smooth animations, enhanced interaction physics, pre-configured shaders, and proximity chat.
body:
# 🌟 SMPCRAFT (1.21.1)

Tired of clunky, overcomplicated modpacks that ruin the vanilla feel? **SMPCRAFT** is a beautifully pre-configured, lightweight Fabric client built from the ground up for one thing: **maximum gameplay comfort on private SMP servers**.

Instead of chasing uselessly high FPS numbers, this pack focuses on premium aesthetics, seamless quality-of-life features, fluid animation feedback, and unmatched immersion for both casual players and content creators.

---

## 🔥 Why Choose SMPCRAFT?

*   **🕹️ Next-Gen Gameplay Comfort:** Experience incredible physical immersion with **Hold My Items** (giving weapons and tools realistic, ergonomic on-screen holding positions) and **CameraOverhaul** for smooth, cinematic head tilts during movement.
*   **🎨 A Living, Fluid World:** Complete out-of-the-box integration of **Fresh Animations** (including Details, Emissive, and Player extensions) combined with **EMF** and **ETF** makes every single mob move with natural, breathtaking fluidness.
*   **🎬 Flawless Media Tools:** Built-in **Flashback** and **pv-addon-flashback** record your gameplay and **Plasmo Voice** proximity chat audio in the background seamlessly. It’s light, convenient, and incredibly easy to use for creating videos or checking server events.
*   **🏃 Enhanced Physics:** Navigate your world with satisfying, responsive movement feedback thanks to **Riptide Roll** (fluid trident rolls) and **Rolling Down in the Deep** (cinematic diving/swimming physics).
*   **🗺️ Clean Navigation:** Stay fully aware of your surroundings with neatly configured **Xaero's Minimap & World Map** along with unobtrusive **Jade** HUD indicators.
